options.name: IELTS for UKVI
options.summary: Academic version at an approved SELT centre; paper or computer.

options.name: PTE Academic UKVI
options.summary: Fully computer-based SELT; possibly faster results.

options.name: Duolingo English Test
options.summary: Accepted by some universities, but not a SELT per the more reliable source.

scores.rationale: Approved SELT, cited by ~13,500 organisations, accepted by Sheffield.
No source gives IELTS result times.
SELT results valid two years per source 8; source 3 claims 12 months for IELTS, unverified.
Approved SELT but ~3,000 organisations accept it.
Standard PTE fast (85.7% in 2 days, 2018) but UKVI turnaround disputed (48h vs 7-10 days).
Not a SELT per source 8; only usable where the university assesses English itself.

recommendation.headline: IELTS for UKVI (Academic) for the widest acceptance; PTE Academic UKVI if speed matters more and your university accepts it
recommendation.summary: IELTS for UKVI is an approved SELT with the widest recognition. Speed evidence for UKVI tests is conflicting and thin.

reasons.text: Approved SELT and broadest recognition (13,500 vs ~3,000 organisations).
Sheffield accepts all IELTS for postgraduate entry.
Paper or computer choice; UKVI version same content as standard IELTS.

tradeoffs.text: No source verifies IELTS result speed; PTE may be faster but UKVI turnaround is disputed.

alternatives.when: Speed is the top priority and your university accepts PTE.
Only if your university explicitly accepts it; do not rely on it as a SELT.

caveats: Sources 3 and 8 disagree on Duolingo SELT status and IELTS validity; source 8 preferred.
Most sources are commercial or undated.
nextSteps: Check your offer letter and GOV.UK for the required test and score.
Book the UKVI version at an approved centre.
Ask the test provider for current result turnaround.

contradictions.topic: Is DET UKVI an approved SELT
contradictions.assessment: Source 8 (Sept 2026, cites gov.uk) says not a SELT; source 3 (single source) says added in 2026. Treat as not a SELT until confirmed on GOV.UK.
Source 8 says two years for SELTs; source 3 says 12 months for IELTS only. Unverified; confirm on GOV.UK.
Undated source 1 says 48 hours; source 3 says 7-10 working days. Neither corroborated.

uncertainties.howToResolve: Ask Pearson or the test centre.

uncertainties.text: No source gives IELTS result times.
Pearson speed data from 2018 and IDP articles from 2023.
